desc: Derive structural characterization: good sequences biject with per-edge coprime ordered factorizations (p_i,q_i) of A_i; sequence is the primitive scaling of a_i = (∏_{j<i} p_j)(∏_{j≥i} q_j); score = ∏_p p^{Σ h_i − N·min h_i}.
Show answer factorizes over primes: Answer = ∏_p W_p with W_p = Σ over sign walks of p^{F}, F = Σ_{t=0}^{N-1} w_t − N·min w_t (D cancels).

Design per-prime DP over positions t=0..N−1 with state d = w − min ≥ 0, accumulated weight p^{acc}; transitions: up (d+e, ×p^{d+e}), down (d−e if d≥e ×p^{d−e}; else d'=0 ×p^{(e−d)t}), stay (×p^d). Complexity O(N·ΣΩ(A_i)) ≈ 9·10⁶.
Verify against Sample 2 (W_3 = 18 ✓) and Sample 1 by hand (W_2 = 194, W_3 = 4843476, product = 939634344 ✓).

Implement final Python program (SPF sieve to 1000, group edges by prime, numpy-vectorized DP with int64 overflow-safe mod, pow() only for d<e below-min transitions, pure-Python fallback), reading stdin and writing answer to stdout.
